description_en: Modifies the configuration of a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance
description_zh: 调用ModifySmartAccessGateway修改智能接入网关的配置
kebab_example: aliyun smartag modify-smart-access-gateway --smart-ag-id sag-0ovhf732a9j0000000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySmartAccessGateway

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the SAG instance.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关的名称。 

长度为2~128个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字，点号（.），下划线（_）和短横线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the SAG instance.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. The description must start with a letter but cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关的描述。 

长度为2~256个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，但不能以`http:// `或` https:/`/开头。
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The CIDR blocks of terminals in the private network. Make sure that the CIDR blocks do not overlap with each other.

If the LAN ports of the terminals use dynamic routing, the IP addresses within the first private CIDR block are allocated to the terminals that have Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) enabled
parameters.help_zh:
线下机构客户端用来通信的私网网段，确保各私网网段不冲突。 

如果智能接入网关终端设备的LAN口配置为动态方式，则线下已开启DHCP的客户端使用的IP地址会从您指定的第一个私网网段中分配。
parameters.name: cidr_block

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the SAG instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关的所属区域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The time during which the disconnected SAG instance remains locked. Valid values: an integer that is greater than or equal to 0.

Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh:
离线锁定功能用户设定的阈值，大于等于0。

单位：秒
parameters.name: security_lock_threshold

parameters.help_en:
The policy that is used to advertise routes to Alibaba Cloud. Valid values:

static: static routing

dynamic: dynamic routing
parameters.help_zh:
线下路由同步方式：

static：静态路由。

dynamic：动态路由
parameters.name: routing_strategy

parameters.example: [ { "adcode":"", "label":"Hangzhou, Zhejiang xx zone xx Road xx number", "value":"B0FFGxxxx", "center":"120.190xxxx, 30.182xxxx", "_new":"true" } ]
parameters.help_en: The location where the SAG instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关所部署的位置
parameters.name: position

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to audit the network connection logs of the SAS app instance.

true: yes

false: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启SAG App连接日志审计。

true：开启SAG App连接日志审计。

false：关闭SAG App连接日志审计
parameters.name: enable_software_connection_audit
